user.title: Set up Jacket Advisor
user.description: Choose only the context you actually want to use. Weather is the only required input; indoor, work and shift context are optional.

basic.name: Basics
basic.description: Weather and optionally a representative living-room temperature for the indoor-to-outdoor transition.

data_description.weather_entity: Weather entity for the current location. Hourly forecasts improve the later/take-with-you recommendation.
data_description.indoor_temperature: Optional representative comfort room, for example the living room. Deliberately unusually warm rooms are less suitable.
data_description.fallback_indoor_temperature: Used when no indoor sensor is selected or when it is temporarily unavailable.
data_description.rain_advice: Assesses precipitation risk separately from warmth. Weather forecasts are never retrained from user feedback.

context.name: Time context (optional)
context.description: A selected calendar can use start/end times only to indicate that a later period may be relevant. Title, description and location are not interpreted.

data_description.context_calendar_entity: Only timed events are considered. An event is explicitly not treated as proof that you are outdoors.

work.name: Work context (optional)
work.description: Can include a significantly different work location. Calendar contents are not interpreted; only time windows are used.

data_description.work_zone: Existing Home Assistant zone used as context/display. Weather itself comes from the separate weather entity below.
data_description.work_weather_entity: Weather entity for the work location. Requires a work/shift calendar or rotating shift cycle.
data_description.work_calendar_entity: Optional. Only start/end times of timed events are used as probable work windows.
data_description.vacation_calendar_entity: Optional. Only overlapping absence windows suppress probable work windows.

shift.name: Rotating shift cycle (optional)
shift.description: Fallback for cycles that are independent of weekdays. Example: F,F,S,S,N,N,N,X,X. F = early, S = late, N = night, X = off.

shared.name: Gemeinsames Wandtablet
shared.description: Nur ausgewählte Home-Assistant-Konten dürfen andere Jackenprofile ansehen oder bewerten.

data_description.shared_user_ids: Normale Benutzer bleiben strikt auf ihr eigenes Profil beschränkt. Administratoren dürfen Profile ebenfalls wechseln.
